recovered_funds.evidence_boundary: This proves reserve recovery to the owner only. It is not bounty funding, GMV, payout, or settlement evidence.

economics.profit_gate: A solver should not claim unless its own bounded compute estimate is below 7.25 USDC, preserving at least a 2x reward-to-compute ratio. Profit is not guaranteed because each solver controls its own model, compute, gas, taxes, and failure risk.

recovery: The owner may cancel while the bounty is open or claimable, then withdraw its contribution.
Anyone may expire a claim after 96 hours; the bounty becomes claimable and the bond becomes completion bonus.
Anyone may expire a submission after 6 hours; the solver bond is returned and the bounty becomes claimable.
After expiry returns the bounty to claimable state, the owner may cancel and withdraw the principal.

scope.goal: Make valid sandboxed-regression submissions deadline-aware and resilient to isolated workflow and RPC-provider failures without delegating verdict or payment authority to the watchdog.
overlap_boundaries: Issue #873 and PR #1255 own read-only stalled-bounty diagnostics and must not be superseded.
PR #997 already owns the committed-subdirectory archive limit fix.
Draft PR #906 is prior art for preflight and per-job isolation; reuse equivalent behavior that reaches main instead of duplicating broad chain or API changes.

funding_gates: The exact benchmark digest is merged through protected main.
The benchmark has deterministic known-good and known-bad rehearsal evidence.
The exact verifier address is ready on the production feed.
A live canary completes runner, signer, relay, and canonical settlement in one round.
The owner cancellation and contributor refund calls are simulated against the exact predicted bounty.
The owner explicitly confirms the exact 14.75 USDC approval and create calls in MetaMask.
evidence_boundary: Only confirmed FundingAdded and BountyBecameClaimable events make this live. Only a confirmed canonical BountySettled event proves solver payment.
